# Research knowledge loop fixtures

Fixtures in this directory are portable descriptive inputs. Tests create all repository roots, checkpoint files, sidecars, and evidence files under pytest temporary directories; fixtures never contain private absolute paths or real hashes.

- `legacy-state.json`: old-shape state concepts with un-attributed annotations and findings. Loading it must not infer activity ownership or convert annotations into findings.
- `loop-receipts.json`: five receipt scenarios: success, unmet goal, blocked execution, annotation-only findings, and multiple loops. Paths and actual file digests are generated by tests.
- `ten-round-history.json`: twenty annotation concepts across ten rounds; early local gain, later audit corrections, and a round nine/ten scope correction. Relationships and evidence are generated in tests using local temporary IDs.

Scenario coverage: SC-001 = all five receipt cases and multiple loops; SC-002 = static help enumeration; SC-003/006 = four result kinds and evidence states; SC-004 = ten-round correction history; SC-005 = terminal follow-up; SC-007 = dataset observation/freeze; SC-008 = failed execution with complete or partial artifacts, preflight failure, retries, and interrupted commit reconciliation.
